First Research Article Fellowship Program at the Max Planck Institute for the History

of Science, Berlin

01 September 2027 – 28 February 2028

The Max Planck Institute for the History of Science ( MPIWG) is offering six-month

fellowships for outstanding graduate students enrolled in doctoral programs based at

Asian, African, or Latin American institutions.

Applicants should demonstrate their commitment to a research topic related to the history of

science, technology, and medicine, or science and technology studies, and a need to work

with an international community at the MPIWG in order to prepare and publish their first

single-authored research paper in English.

First Research Article Fellows will be hosted in one of the following departments:

• Artefacts, Action, Knowledge (AAK – Director: Prof. Dr. Dagmar Schäfer)

• Knowledge Systems and Collective Life (KSCL – Director: Prof. Dr. Etienne Benson)

Regular meetings will be held to support both the writing process and academic

development. Fellows are welcome and encouraged to take part in activities offered by the

Institute and by the International Max Planck Research School “Knowledge and Its

Resources” that take place on our campus.

Candidates are expected to have already completed the relevant research for their thesis and

be in a position to devote six months to writing and preparing an article in English for

journal publication. Fellows must remain enrolled in their home institution’s doctoral

program through the end of the advertised fellowship period.

Fellowships are endowed with a monthly stipend according to the guidelines of the Max

Planck Society (https://www.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/research/projects/first-research-article-

fellowship).

Applicants should submit the following materials in English through our online application

portal:

1. Cover letter explaining how the applicant’s proposed research fits the research

themes of one specific department

1. Official enrollment certificate and confirmation that the applicant will remain

enrolled in an accredited graduate program (PhD) through the end of the

fellowship

1. 500-word description of the dissertation written by the applicant
2. Curriculum vitae (preferably without a photograph) including any publications if

applicable

1. Title, abstract, and outline of article to be completed during the fellowship

(maximum 750 words)

1. English-language writing sample (maximum 8000 words including notes and

bibliography) written by the applicant7. A letter of recommendation from one supervisor

This program is intended to support scholars who wish to improve their academic English.

We encourage you to write your application without the use of AI.

The Max Planck Institute for the History of Science encourages applications from qualified

individuals who belong to groups that are often underrepresented in the workplace due to age,

disability, ethnicity, family status, gender, nationality, race, sex, sexual orientation,

socioeconomic background, or religion.

Please note that only electronic submissions will be accepted. Applications must be

uploaded to the following link on or before 15 January 2027 (23:59 CET):

https://recruitment.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/position/36470793

Finalists may expect a decision by 1 April 2027.

Descriptions of the research projects undertaken by the departments can be found here:

Artifacts, Action, Knowledge (AAK):

https://www.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/research/department/artifacts-action-knowledge

Knowledge Systems and Collective Life (KSCL):

https://www.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/research/department/knowledge-systems-collective-life

For further information, please consult the Frequently Asked Questions at the program’s

website: https://www.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/research/projects/first-research-article-

fellowship.

For all other questions, contact the Publications Manager for this program, Lindy

jobs.occupation: Junior Specialist Treasury - Back Office (m/f/d) - Hybrid Option GER (Leiter/in - Treasury)
jobs.description:
WELCOME TO BASF

In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-oriented.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
Our unit Treasury & Master Data is responsible for the Treasury and Cash Management activity of BASF entities in the EMEA region. Within our Back Office team, we offer you a chance to learn about corporate finance in a diverse, international team.

- You ensure the proper accounting and reconciliation of derivatives, securities, as well as short- and long-term financing and clarify any differences that arise with both, group internal stakeholders and banks.
- In doing so, you carry out counter confirmations and are responsible for the maintenance of business partners for financial transactions within the SAP Treasury Management System (TRM).
- In addition, you are involved in compliance with the reporting regulations, e. g. EMIR.
- As global Netting Center, you manage and administer the framework for smooth Intercompany Netting processes.
- Solution-oriented cooperation, including group-wide interfaces with Treasury and Accounting teams as well as auditors, rounds off your task profile.
- commercial business training or a degree in Business Administration
- first knowledge of Cash Management, Treasury and/or Corporate Finance
- analytical skills along with an interest in and experience with technical and practical business process optimization in SAP FI/TRM as well as MS Office
- fluent in English, further language skills are a plus
- organized and self-reliant way of working to create innovative driving solutions
- open-minded personality, self-confident communication and a distinct feedback mindset

WHAT WE OFFER

- Gross annual salary (full-time): 35.000 - 39.000 €, depending on qualifications and professional experience - In addition, you can expect a bonus dependent on the company's success
- 30 days of paid vacation, special leave and sabbatical options
- Flexible working hours so that you can organize your working and private life according to your needs
- Location-independent working models with defined days of presence in Berlin and residence in Germany - here a first impression
- Work mobile from other EU countries for up to six weeks

HOW TO REACH US

- Katarina Borisov (Talent Acquisition), Tel: +49 30 2005-59269 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You are welcome to book an online appointment.
- You can also reach our recruiting team here.
- First information about our application process can be found here and in our Q&A video.

Rolls-Royce Deutschland brings together a team of more than 3,500 employees from more than 50 nations, pursuing their passion for excellence when it comes to designing, manufacturing and servicing state-of-the-art aerospace engines.

Our headquarters in Dahlewitz near Berlin are home to the company's Development, Assembly and Customer Service units as well as central administrative and strategic departments.

We deliver the best jet engines in the world. Through intelligent innovation and active collaboration, we're putting our customers at the forefront of the aviation industry and we keep them there. Our product portfolio powers more than 35 types of commercial aircraft, and with over 13,000 engines in-service around the world; we're keeping the world flying. We also offer the possibility to write your thesis and student projects together with Rolls-Royce.

Team Accountabilities – How we work / Wie wir arbeiten:

- We are part of Group Indirect Procurement and support the two Rolls-Royce sites in Germany with all non-flying goods and services.
- Our work covers a broad range of requirements: from complex cloud services and infrastructure projects such as assembly halls or engine test beds to consumables for production.
- We combine operational buying, sourcing, supplier management, compliance and close collaboration with internal stakeholders.
- In short: we help our sites get what they need in a practical, commercially sound and compliant way.

Key Accountabilities – What we expect from you / Was wir von dir erwarten:

- Take ownership of operational procurement activities, including creating and following up on purchase orders.
- Support the resolution of invoice and purchase order issues with suppliers, internal customers and other functions.
- Assist with smaller sourcing activities, from clarifying requirements and collecting quotations to comparing offers and preparing award decisions.
- Support smaller supplier negotiations, for example on prices, delivery dates or commercial conditions.
- Help improve data quality, transparency and day-to-day procurement processes.

Qualifications / Qualifikationen:

- Enrolled student at a university or university of applied sciences.
- Good German and English skills; you do not need to be perfect, but you should be willing to use both languages in day-to-day work.
- Structured, reliable and able to work independently after initial guidance.
- Proactive in following up on open topics and asking the right questions when information is missing.
- Interest in procurement, supplier management and business processes.

Pioneer the performance of the future. Join us and you’ll develop your skills and expertise to the very highest levels, working in an international environment for a company known the world over for brilliance and innovation.

Our People are our Power

We are an equal opportunities employer. We’re committed to developing a diverse workforce and an inclusive working environment. We believe that people from different backgrounds and cultures give us different perspectives. And the more perspectives we have, the more successful we’ll be. By building a culture of respect and appreciation, we give everyone who works here the opportunity to realise their full potential.

So that you can be your best at work and home, we’ll consider flexible working arrangements for everyone, in any role.

jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Commodity Manager (f/m/d) CD & NUC, you will shape the sourcing strategy for some of Siemens Energy’s most advanced technology categories, including electronic equipment, controls, digitalization, and nuclear services. Working closely with engineering, quality, and project teams, you will build resilient supplier partnerships, negotiate complex commercial agreements, and ensure a secure, cost-effective supply chain that supports global business growth.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Develop and execute global sourcing and category strategies for electronic equipment, controls, and digital technologies
* Identify, evaluate, and onboard strategic suppliers through market analysis, spend optimization, and cross-functional collaboration
* Build long-term partnerships with key suppliers while driving performance through KPIs, business reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives
* Lead supplier development programs to strengthen quality, capability, and supply chain resilience in technically complex and regulated environments
* Negotiate complex commercial contracts, including pricing, intellectual property, and long-term service agreements, to maximize value and minimize risk
* Proactively assess supply chain risks and implement mitigation strategies to ensure business continuity across global procurement activities

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Economics or a comparable technical or business discipline
* Extensive experience in strategic procurement, sourcing, or category management with a strong focus on electronic equipment and technical commodities
* Proven expertise in managing complex supplier relationships, supplier development, and procurement projects within regulated or high-technology industries
* Strong commercial acumen with advanced contract negotiation, contract management, and risk mitigation capabilities
* Analytical and strategic mindset with excellent stakeholder management skills; knowledge of AI applications and procurement automation is a plus
* Business fluent in German and English

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.description:
What to Expect

Please submit your CV in English in order to be considered for the role.This role is available in Manchester, Amsterdam, and Berlin.This is a 12-month fixed-term contract with the possibility of extension.The Installer Support team serves as an escalation point for our network of channel partners who distribute, install and service residential Tesla energy products. We strive to empower our channel partners to provide the best end-customer experience possible, and we are an end point for determining next steps and solutions for many situations.Installer Support Engineering Technicians offer real-time diagnostics and solutions for trained on-site technicians during installation and maintenance of Tesla’s residential solar, storage and home charging energy products. Strong candidates for this role will already have knowledge in the residential energy industry. Applicants should expect to become a subject matter expert (SME) with Tesla’s energy products with the ability to remotely access and troubleshoot equipment.This is an exciting, fast-paced and rewarding role, and a fantastic opportunity to dig deep into our innovative products while collaborating with some of the most talented people in the world!

What You’ll Do

- Provide top-tier support for live on-site or off-site technical issues regarding residential energy products via phone, chat, email or other channels
- Follow best practices in case handling, follow-up, and documenting interactions and work performed with great detail
- Become highly knowledgeable in the technical operation and complexities of Tesla’s energy products
- Understand and troubleshoot proprietary power electronics systems and their supporting components
- Read and understand single-line diagrams as they pertain to PV and storage systems as well as load and meter component placement
- Review operational logs in proprietary and non-proprietary applications
- Identify trending issues, collect information and report findings to leadership and engineering teams
- Identify process and knowledge gaps and submit feedback that leads to better training and resources
- Become a subject matter expert (SME) in residential Tesla energy products.
- Utilise software including Linux environments, SSH, and more for advanced troubleshooting

What You’ll Bring

- Bachelor's degree in a technical or engineering field, or a minimum of 2+ years’ experience in a technician role
- Fluency in English and German is required for this role 
- Ability to independently make decisions and solve problems with limited direction
- Outstanding written and verbal interpersonal communication skills
- Experience and understanding of customer service, technical support and engineering environments
- Ability to document interactions and steps clearly, accurately and with detail.
- Ability to prioritize workflows effectively according to multiple criteria
- Understanding of electrical theory and experience with emphasis on AC/DC power systems or other electronic systems, devices and components
- Experience troubleshooting metering and communications issues involving many variables
- Understanding of commercial electrical metering, energy flow, power factor, and phase rotation
- Electrical engineering knowledge and/or experience is a plus

Senior Scientist Biological Analysis and Microbiology (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
WELCOME TO BASF

In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-oriented.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
Are you interested in accounting, controlling, manufacturing processes and understanding how product costs are built up? Then join our Product Costing & Inventory Valuation team. In this role, you develop expertise in Cost Accounting, Inventory Valuation and SAP S/4HANA processes while working closely with finance, controlling and operational teams worldwide.

- You support month-end and year-end closing activities, including Product Costing, Inventory Valuation and financial reporting processes.
- You analyze, validate and monitor standard and actual product costs in SAP, including the execution of product costing runs.
- Besides that, you investigate cost deviations, perform root cause analyses and collaborate with manufacturing, accounting and controlling teams to ensure accurate product cost calculations.
- In this role, you review, maintain and validate costing-relevant master data to ensure high data quality and accurate inventory valuation.
- Last but not least, you provide operational support for SAP S/4HANA Product Costing processes and contribute to process improvements, harmonization initiatives and automation projects.
- bachelor's or master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics or a related field
- first experience in accounting, cost accounting, inventory accounting, manufacturing finance or controlling, gained through internships, working student positions or initial professional roles
- good understanding of accounting principles, financial closing processes, cost accounting and inventory valuation, with a strong interest in manufacturing environments
- experience with SAP ERP, SAP CO, Product Costing, Material Ledger or SAP S/4HANA is an advantage
- structured and analytical way of working, strong attention to detail, and fluent English communication skills, additional European languages are a plus

WHAT WE OFFER

- Gross annual salary (full-time): 40.000 - 46.000 €, depending on qualifications and professional experience - In addition, you can expect a bonus dependent on the company's success
- 30 days of paid vacation, special leave and sabbatical options
- Flexible working hours so that you can organize your working and private life according to your needs
- Location-independent working models with defined days of presence in Berlin and residence in Germany - here a first impression
- Work mobile from other EU countries for up to six weeks

HOW TO REACH US

- Katarina Borisov (Talent Acquisition), Tel: +49 30 2005-59269 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You are welcome to book an online appointment.
- You can also reach our recruiting team here.
- First information about our application process can be found here and in our Q&A video.

What to Expect

Tesla is seeking an Account Manager for residential energy sales in Germany. Your core responsibility is B2B sales of Tesla residential and small commercial energy products, with a primary focus on Powerwall 3P — Tesla’s three-phase home battery and integrated inverter, purpose-built for the German and European grid. Following the launch of Powerwall 3P in Germany, you will scale adoption through distributors and third-party installers, grow a high-performing partner network, and drive business development in your region. We are looking for an experienced commercial professional with a background in PV or energy storage. Beyond strong execution and a team-oriented mindset, successful candidates bring creativity, passion, and the drive to lead in a fast-moving technology and market landscape. * This position can be based anywhere in Germany.

What You’ll Do

- Achieve Powerwall 3P and Wall Connector sales targets within assigned channel(s) in Germany
- Build and grow relationships across partner organizations (distributors, installers, and related channels), clearly communicating Tesla’s product portfolio, three-phase value proposition, and feature roadmap
- Drive partner readiness and ramp for Powerwall 3P: onboarding, enablement, pipeline building, and conversion from interest to installed systems
- Evaluate new business opportunities with existing and new accounts and/or sales channels, match suitable product offerings (including Powerwall 3P for three-phase residential and small commercial sites), and own capture of those opportunities
- Deliver market insights to the broader business — including competitive dynamics, installer feedback, and adoption barriers/opportunities specific to three-phase storage in Germany
- Provide accurate sales forecasts to business and manufacturing teams, reflecting Powerwall 3P ramp and channel mix
- Support assessment of market dynamics across sectors (utility, C&I, residential) and drivers (policy/regulatory, economics, grid requirements, incentive programs)
- Represent Tesla at sales and marketing events promoting Powerwall and Powerwall 3P
- Identify and support initiatives that improve partner training, installation quality, fulfilment, and Tesla support — with particular focus on three-phase design, commissioning, and backup use cases
- Provide user and customer feedback to IT on Tesla tools/systems and to Operations on processes

What You’ll Bring

- 5+ years in account management or channel sales within the PV or energy storage industry
- Strong understanding of residential/small commercial energy storage, ideally including three-phase (3P) systems, hybrid inverters, and grid-tied architectures common in Germany
- Working knowledge of grid/utility markets, grid connection practices, and relevant German/EU regulatory and incentive frameworks
- Excellent communication and documentation skills
- Ability to prioritize and run multiple projects and partner workstreams in parallel
- Fluency in English and German
- Flexibility to travel within Germany (and occasionally the broader region)
